summary: Kodiak AI filed an 8-K on May 7, 2026, announcing a private placement of 15,384,609 shares at $6.50 per share and accompanying warrants exercisable at $6.00 per share, for gross proceeds of ~$100M. Investors include new institutional holders, existing stockholders, and an Ares affiliate. The warrants are immediately exercisable, expire in five years, and include cashless exercise provisions. The company intends to use net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation; this is a standard equity financing.
